description: La couverture ciblée - Téléphonie Mobile is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. Location of new mobile telephony antennas under the New Deal Mobile program – targeted coverage. Coverage: Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. The portal shows the English title as "Targeted coverage – Mobile Phone" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. Its keywords include antenne, telephonie, territoires-agriculture-et-innovations. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, JSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2025-01-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
